name: Browser Use
summary: Browser Use Cloud: the status, steps and results of agent runs, and the account.

api_key.description: A Browser Use Cloud API key (cloud.browser-use.com > API keys). Sent in the X-Browser-Use-API-Key header, without a Bearer prefix.

notes: Agent runs use the Cloud API v4 (/v4/...); the account and credit balance is only on v2 (/v2/billing/account). V2 tasks are legacy.
A run is asynchronous: create it, poll runs.status every couple of seconds until completed, failed or cancelled, then read runs.get once. A client timeout does not cancel the run; runs.cancel does.
Runs bill model and search usage against maxCostUsd (new API sessions default to $25) plus browser time; keys in one project share credits and concurrency.
Browser sessions for CDP, profiles, workspaces, network policies, integrations and skills are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get account and credit balance
endpoints.summary: Project id, credit balance, concurrent session limit and active session count for the key.
notes: rateLimit in the answer is a legacy alias for concurrency, not requests per second.

endpoints.name: Get run status
endpoints.summary: Just the run's status: queued, dispatching, running, completed, failed or cancelled.
notes: The cheap poll target. Poll until a terminal status, then fetch runs.get once.

endpoints.name: Get a run
endpoints.summary: The full run summary: task, status, final output and cost.

endpoints.name: Get run events
endpoints.summary: The run's step-by-step events, paged by event id.

after.description: Return only events after this event id. Default 0 (from the start).

include_output.description: Include each event's output. Default true.

notes: For incremental polling pass back the highest event id you have seen as after.

endpoints.name: List runs
endpoints.summary: Runs in the project, newest first, optionally for one session.

cursor.description: Keyset cursor from a previous response.
